html:
G'oya

Har bir oy uchun o'sha oyda kirganlar to'plamini olamiz. Uchala oyda ham bo'lganlar bu uch to'plamning kesishmasi: ikkita INTERSECT. Ismni users jadvalidan id bo'yicha olamiz.

Yechim

SELECT id, name
FROM users
WHERE id IN (
  SELECT user_id FROM logins
  WHERE login_date >= '2024-01-01' AND login_date < '2024-02-01'
  INTERSECT
  SELECT user_id FROM logins
  WHERE login_date >= '2024-02-01' AND login_date < '2024-03-01'
  INTERSECT
  SELECT user_id FROM logins
  WHERE login_date >= '2024-03-01' AND login_date < '2024-04-01'
)

Oy oralig'i "birinchi kundan keyingi oyning birinchi kunigacha" ko'rinishida yozilgan. Shunda 29-fevral ham, 31-mart ham o'z oyiga tushadi va har oyning oxirgi kunini eslab yurish shart emas.

Tuzoqlar

Kirishlarni sanash yetmaydi. Malika yanvarda uch marta kirgan, lekin fevralda umuman kirmagan. COUNT(*) >= 3 uni faol deb hisoblaydi:

Noto'g'riSELECT id, name FROM users
WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM logins
             WHERE login_date >= '2024-01-01' AND login_date < '2024-04-01'
             GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3)

Faqat oy raqamiga qarash ham xato. Bekzod 2023 yilning yanvarida kirgan, 2024 yilning yanvarida esa yo'q. Oy bilan birga yil ham tekshirilishi kerak.

UNION kesishma emas, birlashma: u uchta oyning kamida bittasida kirgan hammani beradi.

Boshqa yo'l

Chorak ichidagi kirishlarni foydalanuvchi bo'yicha guruhlab, nechta har xil oy borligini sanash mumkin. Sanani matnga aylantirib, birinchi 7 belgisini olsak, oy kaliti chiqadi ('2024-02'):

SELECT u.id, u.name
FROM users u
JOIN logins l ON l.user_id = u.id
WHERE l.login_date >= '2024-01-01' AND l.login_date < '2024-04-01'
GROUP BY u.id, u.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT SUBSTR(CAST(l.login_date AS TEXT), 1, 7)) = 3
